definition: a dried piece of wood used as fuel.
example_en: Grandmother stored the dried firewood needed for cooking.

definition: to run vehemently; to move with force.
example_en: That boy came running vehemently to school.

definition: a written plea, appealing for some help or sympathy; a petition.
example_en: The student submitted a petition to the school.

definition: a forest; jungle; woods.
example_en: Snakes increase in the forest during the rainy season.

definition: to hand over; to deliver.
example_en: He handed over the letter to the officer.

definition: to come close to, toward.
example_en: The ship came close to the shore.

definition: a trembling or tremulous agitation in the earth surface caused by an earthquake.
example_en: The earth trembled suddenly at night.

definition: to exercise authority over; to rule; to administer; to direct; to control; to manage, to govern.
example_en: That king ruled the country justly.

definition: a group of stars which can be configured into a particular, but arbitrary form; a constellation.
example_en: The constellation is clearly visible in the night sky.

definition: to render (something) useless.
example: ಅವನ ಸುಳ್ಳು ಸುದ್ದಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ನಂಬಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಳ್ಳುಗಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His false news rendered everyone's trust useless.

definition: to make another believe.
example_en: He told a lie and made people believe it.

definition: to become folded; to have folds.
example_en: After washing, the cloth became well folded.

definition: a man whose occupation is writing; an author; a writer.
example_en: That writer has written many books.

definition: complaint, dissatisfaction, etc. expressed in a low, indistinct voice.
example_en: The people's low murmur of complaint could be heard throughout the meeting.

definition: the quality or fact of being bent, crooked; crookedness.
example: ಆ ಕೋಲಿನ ಮೊಱಕು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The crookedness of that stick was easily noticeable.

definition: with a jarring sound.
example_en: The thunder made a jarring sound.

definition: anything that is covered or wrapped up with a woollen blanket.
example_en: She wrapped the child with a woollen blanket.

definition: the lustre of gold.
example_en: The lustre of the gold ornament attracted everyone's eyes.

definition: the defence of a fortified place.
example_en: The fortress defense was strengthened against the enemy's attack.

definition: the philosophic doctrine that matter is the only reality and that everything in the world, including thought, will and feeling can be explained only in terms of matter; materialism.
example_en: Materialism does not accept the existence of the soul.

definition: a dull witted person; a stupid.
example_en: Everyone knew that he was a dull-witted person.

definition: great ability or proficiency; expertness that comes from training, practice, etc.; skill.
example_en: He has immense skill in music.

definition: sharpened (on a whet-stone); whetted.
example: ಆ ಕ್ಷುತ ಕತ್ತಿ ಒಂದೇ ಏಟಿಗೆ ಕಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That whetted sword cuts in a single stroke.

definition: to be indifferent; to be lacking concern, interest or feeling; to show apathy.
example_en: He showed indifference to everyone's words.

definition: the act of overseeing, managing (work, workers, a project, etc.); supervision; superintendence.
example_en: Supervising the building construction work is his responsibility.

definition: anything used to embellish something or someone; an ornament.
example_en: The actress came to the stage adorned with ornaments.

definition: a variety in cardamom plant.
example_en: The farmers planted the surusurike cardamom variety.

definition: a pair of earthen oven.
example: ಅಡುಗೆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೂಡೊಲೆ ಇಟ್ಟು ಅಡುಗೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They set up a pair of earthen ovens in the kitchen and cooked.

definition: the the act of associating, joining with or the state, fact of being associated, joined with; association.
example_en: The association of the two societies made the work easier.

definition: the chest - a) that part of the mammalian body between the neck and the abdomen in whose cavity the heart and lungs lie; b) the middle of the three chief divisions of the body of an insect or the corresponding part of a crustacean or an arachnid; c) the fore or ventral part of the body between the neck and the abdomen in humans.
example_en: The arrow pierced his chest.

definition: to cause to have majesty or grandeur.
example: ಆ ಅರಮನೆ ತನ್ನ ವೈಭವದಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ದೆಖ್ಖಾಳಂಗುಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That palace filled everyone with a sense of majesty and grandeur.

definition: to crush; to squeeze.
example_en: The cook crushed the garlic.

definition: to cause to remain backward or at the rear portion.
example_en: They advanced, leaving the weak soldiers to remain at the rear.

definition: a bent, crooked, crippled hand.
example_en: Everyone felt pity seeing his crooked hand.

definition: a piece of metal stamped and issued by the authority of a government for use as money; a monetary coin.
example_en: He kept a coin in his pocket.

definition: the condition of being burnt from within without any outward sign; smouldering.
example_en: Only a smouldering remained in his mind.

definition: to cause to say, utter something or make a statement.
example_en: The officer made the witness state the truth.

definition: a kind of a lung disease.
example: ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಹುಟ್ಟುಶ್ವಾಸ ಎಂಬ ಶ್ವಾಸಕೋಶ ರೋಗ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The child had a lung disease called huttushvasa.

definition: the state of being convinced (completely).
example_en: The judge became completely convinced from the evidence.

definition: a joining together of two or more things, persons in a right and comfortable manner.
example: ಎರಡು ಊರುಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಬಿಸುಗೆ ಏರ್ಪಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: A connecting link of a road was formed between the two villages.

definition: a series of names, words, numbers, etc. set forth in order; a list.
example_en: He prepared the list of invitees.

definition: the quality of adhereing, blending with or the fact of being adhered firmly or fused with, another.
example_en: The stickiness of the glue has held the cloth firmly.

definition: a raised ground; a small hill, hillock, mound.
example: ಊರಿನ ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಗುನ್ನ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: A small hillock is visible outside the village.

definition: he who is master of himself; an independent, self-willed man.
example_en: That merchant is known as one who is master of himself.

definition: a comb for clearing of nits and lice from the head.
example_en: She removed the lice from her head with a nit comb.

definition: a disease or fever caused by impaired digestion.
example_en: He suffered from a fever caused by impaired digestion due to indigestion.

definition: an idea or opinion formed from evidence that is neither positive nor conclusive; a belief that (someone) to be guilty of something on little or no evidence or a belief that (someone or something) to be bad, wrong, harmful or questionable; an unproven doubt; a suspicion; a surmise.
example: ಅವನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಗುಮಾನ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: People developed a suspicion about him.

definition: a place where the funds of the government, of a corporation or the like are deposited, kept, and disbursed; a treasury.
example_en: The officer carefully guards the keys of the treasury.

definition: a king.
example_en: That king ruled his subjects with love.

definition: a swollen, inflamed area in body tissues, in which pus gathers; abscess.
example_en: The doctor removed his abscess through surgery.

definition: a regulatory restriction; a rule; a manner prescribed not to be violated.
example: ಈ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಲ್ಗೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೆಲವು ಅಡಕೆ ನಿಯಮಗಳಿವೆ.
example_en: There are certain restrictive rules to participate in this competition.

definition: any animal that lives mainly on grass, as cattle, deer, etc.
example: ಹಸು ಮತ್ತು ಜಿಂಕೆಗಳಂತಹ ಪುಲ್ಮಿಗಗಳು ಹುಲ್ಲನ್ನೇ ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: Grass-eating animals like cows and deer eat only grass.

definition: the work of weaving fabrics on looms.
example_en: She does the weaving of the sari on a handloom.

definition: the fact of knowing another person, but not intimately.
example: ಅವರ ನಡುವೆ ಕೇವಲ ಮೊಗವಱಿಕೆ ಇತ್ತು, ಸ್ನೇಹವಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Between them there was only a casual acquaintance, not friendship.

definition: to roll from one side to the other.
example_en: The child was rolling from side to side on the bed.

definition: to make (another) proud of.
example_en: That remark made him proud.

definition: a man not equipped with weapons; an unarmed man.
example: ಬಱುವನಾಗಿದ್ದ ಆ ಸೈನಿಕ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಎದುರು ನಿಂತನು.
example_en: That unarmed soldier stood before the enemies.

definition: weariness from physical or mental exertion; exhaustion.
example_en: He went to sleep early due to the exhaustion of the journey.

definition: a man who has inherited an estate.
example_en: That heir received his father's estate.

definition: the plant Arubyn oritense.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂಲಿ ಗಿಡ ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The pūli plant grows abundantly in that forest.

definition: the wormlike larva of a butterfly; a caterpillar.
example_en: A caterpillar was eating the leaves in the garden.

definition: any of the young people who, in their alienation from conventional society, turn variously to mysticism, psychedelic drugs, communal living, etc.; hippie.
example: ಆ ಹಿಪ್ಪಿ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಳ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That hippie was living a simple life in the village.

definition: not soft; hard; rigid.
example_en: The weave of this cloth is hard and rough.

definition: to cause to dig; to get excavated.
example_en: The contractor got the well dug by the workers.

definition: a metal pin with a pointed end and a round head, used to fasten papers together; a paper pin.
example_en: She fastened the papers together with a paper pin.

definition: a utensil with a rough surface on which to grate coconut, vegetables, etc.; a grater.
example_en: They grated coconut on the grater.

definition: to force to go; to push out; to expel.
example_en: The guard pushed the thief out of the house.

definition: a cluster, a bunch, a collection of hairs, threads, feathers, flowers, grass etc. held or fastened together at one end.
example_en: She fastened the cluster of flowers into her hair.

definition: a contingent of watchmen, guards or sentries.
example_en: At night a contingent of watchmen stood near the gate.

definition: an upset of normal function in the body; ailment; bodily disorder.
example_en: He has recently developed a bodily disorder.

definition: a small frying pan.
example_en: She fried the fritters in the small frying pan.

definition: a god; a deity.
example_en: The gods churned the ocean for ambrosia.

definition: the entrance of a house.
example_en: The guests stood waiting at the entrance of the house.

definition: a going back; a retreat; withdrawal.
example_en: The soldiers' retreat took place at night.

definition: to sink or bend from weight or pressure.
example_en: The back bent from the weight of the heavy sack.

definition: to elaborately explain; to interpret in detail.
example_en: The teacher elaborately explained that subject in detail.

definition: popularly referred to Mahatma Mohandas Karamachand Gandhi, who is regarded as the father of the nation by Indians.
example_en: Gandhi achieved independence through the path of nonviolence.

definition: a tender basil twig.
example_en: She plucked the tender sprouted basil twig for worship.

definition: to put on a (different) form, shape.
example_en: God put on the form of a man.

definition: a round wooden dish used to knead dough in.
example_en: Mother kneaded the dough in the round wooden dish.

definition: a water-vessel as a boat or ship.
example_en: The boat carried goods across the river.

definition: the act or a person or thing that runs; running.
example_en: His run became the first in the whole school.

definition: immediately; without delay.
example: ಅವನು ಕರೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಧಿಕ್ಕನೆ ಓಡಿ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: Hearing the call he came running immediately, without delay.

definition: a kind of hibiscus plant..
example_en: The hibiscus plant had bloomed in the courtyard.

definition: white as milk; milky.
example_en: Her face shone milky white.

definition: a male offspring of a brāhmaṇa and a sūdra woman.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಮಾಲೇರು ಎಂಬ ಜಾತಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿದವನು.
example_en: That boy belonged to the caste called māleru.

definition: one's female parent; mother.
example_en: The mother sang a lullaby to the child.

definition: an expedition or struggle undertaken for a holy, esp. religious, purpose; crusade.
example: ಅವರು ಜಹಾದ್ ಎಂದು ಕರೆದು ಜನರನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They called it a holy crusade and gathered the people.

definition: a vanishing from sight; disappearance.
example_en: The disappearance of that bird happened in a moment.

definition: a tree of Ebenaceae family, ( Diospyros ebenum or D. pergrina( =D. embryopteris) ?) whose fruits are edible.
example: ಬಾಳಾಯಿ ಮರದ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಸಂತೋಷದಿಂದ ತಿಂದರು.
example_en: The children happily ate the fruits of the Balaayi tree.

definition: an absolute ruler; a king with unlimited powers; a despot.
example_en: The people lived in fear under the despot's rule.

definition: to cause (members of a society, council, etc. or a large number of people) to assemble (for purpose of discussion, public announcement, etc.); to convene a meeting.
example_en: The village leaders convened a meeting for discussion.

definition: entire; complete; whole.
example_en: He repaid the loan entirely.

definition: a slender stick perfumed with musk or musk-preparation.
example: ಅವಳು ಕಸ್ತೂರಿಕಡ್ಡಿಯನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಸೀರೆಯ ಸೆರಗಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: She kept a slender stick perfumed with musk in the edge of her sari.

definition: a recurrent disorder of the nervous system, characterised either by mild, episodic loss of attention or sleepiness or by severe convulsions with loss of consciousness, accompanied by convulsions, physical dysfunction, etc.; epilepsy.
example_en: That boy had epilepsy since childhood.

definition: deep mud, that is thoroughly wet; soggy earth; mire.
example_en: After the rain, the path was filled with deep mud.

definition: any of the six or seven great divisions of land on the globe (as Asia, Africa, Australia, Europe, North and South America, Europe, and sometimes, Antarctica); a continent.
example_en: Asia is the largest continent in the world.

definition: to become luminous, effulgent; to start giving off light.
example_en: As the sun rose, the sky began to shine.

definition: burnt; consumed by fire.
example_en: The house that was burnt by fire turned to ashes.

definition: writing done by hand, with pen, pencil, etc.; hand-writing.
example_en: His handwriting is very beautiful.

definition: a petty folk goddess.
example_en: The shrine of the folk goddess Paṭlāyi is outside the village.

definition: that which is somewhat salty.
example: ಕರಾವಳಿಯ ಬಾವಿಗಳ ನೀರು ಸೌಳಾಗಿ ರುಚಿ ಕೆಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The water of the coastal wells is somewhat salty and spoils the taste.

definition: an able woman.
example: ಆ ಗಟಾಣಿ ಮನೆಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನೂ ಒಬ್ಬಳೇ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: That able woman managed all the household work by herself.

definition: a bow-shaped eye-brow.
example: ಆ ಬಾಲಕನ ಕುಡುವುರ್ವು ತುಂಬಾ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That boy's bow-shaped eyebrow looked very handsome.

definition: a woman who organises; an organiser.
example_en: She is the organiser of this event.

definition: an exciting or being excited as by a light touch or stroke with the finger, a feather, etc., causing involuntary twitching, a pleasant tingling, laughter, etc.; tickle; tickling.
example_en: When touched with a feather, she felt a tickle and laughed.

definition: an instance of resorting to brutal methods for resorting or settling issues instead of amicable or legal methods.
example_en: A brutal clash occurred between the two groups.

definition: lacking good sense; lacking normal intelligence; foolish; stupid.
example_en: He is a fool, he understands nothing.

definition: a kind of large mounted gun; a cannon.
example_en: A large cannon was placed on the fort's wall.

definition: the sharp blade (of a weapon).
example_en: The sharp blade of that sword was very keen.

definition: a male sheep.
example_en: That ram had grown strong and sturdy.

definition: a kind of tiny insect with wings.
example_en: During the rainy season, the tiny winged insect flew around the lamp.

definition: a deceitful, dissimulating statement.
example_en: Everyone was deceived after hearing his dissimulating statement.

definition: the revelation of a seer.
example_en: The revelations of the seer are compiled in that book.

definition: compared; likened.
example: ಅವನ ಸಾಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಮಹಾನ್ ವೀರರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಉಪಮಿತ ಮಾಡಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: His achievement was likened to that of great heroes.

definition: the export trade or business.
example_en: The country's export trade increased this year.

definition: in a clumsy, disorderly, haphazard manner.
example: ಗಾಬರಿಯಾದ ಅವನು ಎರ್ರಿಬಿರ್ರಿ ಆಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಎಸೆದನು.
example_en: Panicked, he threw everything about in a clumsy, disorderly manner.

definition: the quality of being worthless, useless; worthlessness.
example_en: The worthlessness of that object was known to everyone.

definition: to go down or rest on the knees (as in praying); to kneel.
example: ಅವನು ರಾಜನ ಮುಂದೆ ಡೊಗ್ಗಾಲೂರಿ ಕ್ಷಮೆ ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He knelt before the king and asked for forgiveness.

definition: any of tropical or subtropical birds of Psittaciformes order, with a hooked bill, brightly coloured feathers, and feet having two toes pointing forward and two backward, some of which can learn to imitate human speech; a parrot.
example_en: The child tried to imitate the parrot's speech.

definition: not pertaining to or not requiring help of, the intellect.
example: ಆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಅಬೌದ್ಧಿಕವಾಗಿ, ಕೇವಲ ಭಾವನೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That decision was taken not through intellect, but purely on emotion.

definition: a kind of rock.
example_en: This kind of rock is found abundantly on this hill.

definition: a genus of fish; .
example_en: In that pond there are fish called iliyambu.

definition: to utter a loud, sharp, piercing cry; to scream; to screech.
example_en: The child screamed loudly and called its mother.

definition: any of various wading birds (esp. subfamily Ardeinae) with a long neck, long legs, and a long, tapered bill, living along marshes and river banks; a heron.
example: ಕೆರೆಯ ದಂಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಕ ಪಕ್ಷಿ ಮೀನಿಗಾಗಿ ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The heron was waiting for fish on the bank of the pond.

definition: an instrument with which high temperatures, beyond the range of ordinary thermometers, are measured; a pyrometer.
example_en: They measure the furnace's high temperature with a pyrometer in the factory.

definition: emotional attachment; affection; special inclination towards.
example: ಸಂಗೀತದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಬಾಲ್ಯದಿಂದಲೂ ಉತ್ಸುಕತನ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: She had had a fond inclination towards music since childhood.

definition: the tip of the finger-nail.
example: ಅವಳ ಉಗುರುಗೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಬಿಳಿ ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: A small white spot appeared at the tip of her fingernail.

definition: an increasing, developing, progressing or being increased, developed.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಸಂವರ್ಧನೆಗಾಗಿ ಹೊಸ ಯೋಜನೆ ಜಾರಿಗೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: A new plan was implemented for the development of the village.

definition: to look at; to see.
example_en: The devotees looked upon the god.

definition: to roll (oneself) on the ground.
example_en: The horse rolled on the grass and got up.

definition: a man skilled in rhetorics and poetics.
example_en: That rhetorician explained the figures of speech in the poem.

definition: not ripe; green; unripe.
example_en: Unripe mangoes were being sold in the market.

definition: a street or row of jewellery shops.
example_en: There are gold shops on the jewellery street.

definition: a minor, wicked daemon deity, supposed to exercise magic powers; an elf.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನ ಕುಟ್ಟಿಚಾತಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆದರಿ ದೀಪ ಆರಿಸಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The villagers, afraid of the wicked daemon deity, did not put out the lamp.

definition: the act of colonisation at a place away from one's native land and influencing unduly the life, trade and commerce of local people and the local government, for one's advantage.
example: ಆ ದೇಶದ ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸಾಹತುಷಾಹಿಯ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The influence of colonization was great in that country's history.

definition: a sound.
example_en: A strange sound came from the forest.

definition: a person who has committed a sinful act; a sinner.
example: ಆ ಪಾತಕಿ ತನ್ನ ಪಾಪಕ್ಕೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ ಅನುಭವಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That sinner suffered punishment for his sin.

definition: a heavy blow.
example_en: The heavy blow of the pickaxe broke the rock.

definition: any of the celestial objects with apparent motion (as the sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, etc.).
example_en: Many celestial bodies keep moving in the sky.

definition: to be plundered, looted.
example_en: The village was plundered by the attack of the enemies.

definition: at or during the very midnight.
example_en: At the very midnight the whole town was silent.

definition: a (usu.) single sheet of paper containing some publicity matter printed, written on, for purpose of distribution widely; a pamphlet.
example_en: The organizers distributed the pamphlet on the street.

definition: to be covered (with).
example_en: The sky was covered with clouds.

definition: the red blood.
example_en: Red blood was oozing from the wound.

definition: a breaking or being broken.
example_en: He fell because of the chair breaking.

definition: a small device consisting of a glass, metal or hard rubber tube, with a narrow tip, and fitted with either a piston or a rubber bulb for drawing in a quantity of fluid or for ejecting fluid in a stream; a syringe.
example_en: The nurse injected the medicine using the syringe.

definition: a person who helps others (in need); a benefactor.
example: ಉಪಕಾರಿ ತನ್ನ ಹಣದಿಂದ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The benefactor helped the poor with his own money.

definition: toward a higher place, position, degree, amount, etc.; upward.
example_en: He climbed the steps upward.

definition: the plant Ferula assafoetida of Apiaceae family.
example_en: They use this plant's asafoetida in cooking.

definition: hurriedly; hastily.

definition: a subordinate committee chosen from among the members of a main committee to carry out special assignments; a sub-committee.
example_en: A sub-committee was formed for this work.

definition: the condition of severe dearth of food.
example_en: That year, without rain, there was a severe dearth of food.

definition: in a right or proper manner; correctly; appropriately.
example_en: He does every task in the proper manner.

definition: dried grass, leaves, twigs, etc.
example_en: He gathered the dried grass and lit a fire.

definition: a man who jests; a jester.
example_en: That jester used to make everyone laugh.

definition: a thing that is interwoven, connected closely or intricately.
example_en: The rope's twist was tied tightly together.

definition: a post, on the roadside, esp. at cross roads, carrying a board giving direction for different destinations; a hand-post.
example: ಸಂತೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ತೋರುಮರ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: A hand-post appeared on the way to the fair.

definition: a wicked plot to overthrow a ruler, government or to cheat in a heinous manner.
example_en: The ministers hatched a wicked plot against the king.

definition: outward form or appearance; aspect; semblence.
example_en: Everyone was deceived by his outward appearance.

definition: the act or process of moving; movement.
example_en: The army's movement was carried out with great discipline.

definition: a troubling or being troubled; trouble; vexation; difficulty.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸದಿಂದ ನನಗೆ ಬಹಳ ತೊಂದರೆ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: I suffered a lot of trouble because of this work.

definition: to stir, beat or shake (curd) to form butter.
example_en: Grandmother churned the curd to extract butter.

definition: to attract by charm, temptation etc.; to fascinate; to entice; to lure.
example_en: The sweetness of the song lured the girl.

definition: a becoming or the condition of being sterile, useless.
example: ಆ ಭೂಮಿಯ ಬಾಧ್ಯತ್ವ ಕೃಷಿಗೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The sterility of that land became a big problem for farming.

definition: the climbing plant Abrus precatorius of Papilionaceae family; wild liquorice weather plant.
example: ಗುಲುಗಂಜಿ ಬಳ್ಳಿಯ ಕೆಂಪು ಬೀಜಗಳನ್ನು ಆಭರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The red seeds of the guluganji creeper are used for ornaments.

definition: a lean, lanky leg.
example_en: The boy's lanky leg kept striking as he ran.

definition: the door that is open.
example_en: They kept the open door ajar so the breeze would come in.

definition: the act or an instance of burning.
example_en: The smell of burning still lingered in the forest.

definition: to hold water in.
example_en: This lake holds plenty of water during the rainy season.

definition: to become cool or colder.
example_en: Water becomes cold quickly in winter.

definition: to give or provide place or room.
example_en: He gave everyone room to sit.

definition: the plant Eugenia argentea of Myrtaceae family.
example_en: The Eugenia argentea tree grows on the slope of the hill.

definition: a place where things are stored; a warehouse; a storehouse.
example_en: They stored the grain in the storehouse.

definition: a thin mat made of bamboo sticks.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅತ್ತರುತಟ್ಟಿ ಹಾಸಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They had spread a thin bamboo mat on the floor of that house.

definition: (masc.) one skilled in oology; oologist.
example: ಆ ಅಂಡಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞ ಪಕ್ಷಿಗಳ ಮೊಟ್ಟೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That oologist does research on the eggs of birds.

definition: (rhet.) an analogy which points out the similarity between two objects likened.
example: ಕವಿ ತನ್ನ ಪದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಂದರ ಧರ್ಮೋಪಮೆ ಬಳಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet used a beautiful analogy in his verse.

definition: any substance or substances used in treating disease or illness; medicament; remedy; medicine.
example_en: The doctor gave medicine for the fever.

definition: (a plant) to put forth a new branch or branches.
example: ಆ ಮರ ವಸಂತಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಕೊಂಬೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮೈಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That tree puts forth new branches in spring.

definition: (dial.) a kind of bird which cries in the night and is believed to forebode ill-omen.
example_en: When the ill-omened bird cried at night, the villagers were frightened.

definition: a tall person.
example_en: That tall person was easily visible in the crowd.

definition: spread; covering a wide area.
example_en: During the rainy season, greenery had spread over a wide area.

definition: the way or manner in which aesthetic sense, and sentiments are dealt with.
example: ಕವಿಯ ರಸಮಾರ್ಗವು ಕಾವ್ಯದ ಭಾವನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The poet's way of handling sentiments shows the emotions of the poem well.

definition: a burning sensation in the stomach.
example: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮಸಾಲೆ ತಿಂದ ಕಾರಣ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯುರಿ ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Because he ate too much spicy food, he got a burning sensation in his stomach.
